```{r}
# Helper functions
ensure_final_period <- function(x){

   tryCatch({
  x <- ifelse(substring(x,
                           nchar(x),
                            nchar(x)) != ".",
                    paste0(x, "."),
                    x)
   }, error = function(e) {
    x <- ""
   })
  
  return(x)
}

remove_final_period <- function(x){
  tryCatch({
    x <- ifelse(substring(x,
                           nchar(x),
                            nchar(x)) == ".",
                    str_replace_all(x, "\\.", ""),
                    x)
  }, error = function(e) {
    x <- ""
   })
  
  return(x)
}

prep_data <- function(sheet_name){
  
  df <- read_sheet(ss=url,
                   sheet=sheet_name) |>
    janitor::clean_names() |>
    mutate(across(everything(), ~as.character(.x))) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x, ""))) |>
    mutate(across(everything(), ~str_trim(.x, "both"))) |>
    mutate(
      author = ensure_final_period(author),
      title = remove_final_period(title),
      journal = remove_final_period(journal),
      author = ensure_final_period(author),
      volume = remove_final_period(volume),
      issue = remove_final_period(issue),
      doi = remove_final_period(doi),
      link = remove_final_period(link),
      link = case_when(
        # only doi
        link == "" & doi != "" ~ 
          glue::glue("{doi}"),
        # doi and link
        link != "" & doi != "" ~ 
          glue::glue("{str_replace(doi, 'https://doi.org/', '')}. {link}"),
        # link no doi
        link != "" & doi == "" ~ 
          glue::glue("{link}"),
        .default = ""
      )
    )
  
  return(df)
}

format_software <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      markdown = glue::glue("{author} ({year}). *{title}* [{journal}]. {link}")
    )
}

format_journal <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(volume_issue = case_when(
      issue != "" ~ glue::glue("*{volume}*({issue})"),
      .default = glue::glue("*{volume}*")),
    markdown = glue::glue("{author} ({year}). *{title}*. {journal}. {volume_issue}. {link}")
    )
}

format_preprint <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
    markdown = glue::glue("{author} ({year}). *{title}*. {journal}. {link}")
    )
}

format_tech_report <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
    markdown = glue::glue("{author} ({year}). *{title}* [{journal}]. {volume}. {link}")
    )
}


format_conf <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
    markdown = glue::glue("{author} ({year}). *{title}* [{type}]. {venue}. {link}")
    )
}


finalize_data <- function(df) {
  x <- df |>
    mutate(markdown = str_replace_all(markdown, "\\{|\\}", ""),
         markdown = str_replace_all(markdown, "Schmidt, A.", "**Schmidt, A.**"),
         markdown = str_trim(markdown, "both")) |>
    pull(markdown)
  
  cat(paste(x), sep = '\n\n')
}
```
